//: Every key matches a field of VaultConfig in app/config.py. Keys starting with // are ignored, the way the appsettings.json comments were. Anything left out keeps its default; environment variables (FILEVAULT_ROOT_PATH, ...) override what is here.
//allowed_extensions: While this is non-empty it is the whole policy: nothing outside it is served, and the block lists never come into play.
//content_type_mappings: serve_unknown_file_types is off, so every allowed extension needs a type here or in Python's built-in table, or it is refused rather than served.
//case_insensitive: The vault came off NTFS, where case never mattered. With this on, a request whose spelling differs only by case still finds the file instead of 404ing.
